articles.title: I would not have voted for Zionism motion, Polanski says
articles.description: A motion declaring Zionism a form of racism was passed by Green Party members on Sunday.

articles.title: Chris Mason: Questions remain for Green Party leader Zack Polanski
articles.description: Senior party figures have criticised his response to a motion passed by members declaring Zionism a form of racism.

articles.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
articles.description: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

articles.title: Fort Hood survivor supports gunman's execution by firing squad but questions livestream
articles.description: Alonzo Lunsford tells the BBC the punishment befits the crime but he has some doubts whether the public should be able to watch it.
